name: Aureobalo
backstory: Banker en route. Travels the Terfila-Khol Moshin route by car. It's not known where he got his fortune - he arrived one day from afar with it already in hand. He was generous with it, so people didn't press him on where it came from. His name resembles those of people who fought in the Guerras de Görff, on the losing side, though he isn't related to them; his parents were great admirers of the loyalists, an association he was never comfortable inheriting.

3% geography (skewed: geography, geology, region, coast, mountain, river) - he likes maps

experience: Ran into Farlis at a bar in Salthos Cruzados, the first evening of the Feria del Milenio — already knew him from before (their routes cross), but a first for meeting at this particular place.

Brought up a vague, secondhand version of a story about Farlis and a castle — someone correcting him over 'the stones someone had to hold up' — and got it confirmed directly from Farlis that it was about him, and that Khaoe was the one who said it.
Same evening, same bar: ran into Khaasan, just passing through Salthos Cruzados on his way from Khan Ice. Bought him a drink for the long road; Khaasan said he prefers short ones.
Also met Bardaglis and Khaoe at that same bar that night; left before the others, citing an early drive back to Khol Moshin the next morning.
Postponed his drive back to Khol Moshin by a day to stay a second day at the Feria.
Carried Khaoe's rebuttal about the castle back to Farlis himself rather than repeat it elsewhere - explicitly, so he would not be the one spreading it behind his back.
Told Farlis, for the first time aloud, that his surname resembles the losing side of the Guerras de Gorff, that he is unrelated to them, and that his parents' admiration was never his choice.

Picked up from Farlis: that he arrived at the Collective with a Terfila surname and deliberately left it behind, and that nobody there leads for a surname - confirmed firsthand rather than as something said.

criterion.standard: counts only what he has given away, since it is the one part of the money he chose
criterion.wasted_life: one where the name he inherited did the talking for him
criterion.trusts: a story he can carry back to whoever it is about and have them say it plainly
criterion.distrusts: a name that arrives ahead of the person
cost_ledger: Carried a vague secondhand version of the castle story to Farlis's face and had to be corrected on it - the price of always taking a story back to its subject (farlis_aureobalo_bar_salthos_cruzados).
Chose to tell Farlis to his face what Khaoe had said about him, rather than hold a story he would then be carrying around unspoken (aureobalo_farlis_castillo_en_miniatura).
